reconcile.note: Gill concedes Jesus held private conversations with the disciples but argues their content only restated or explained what he had already taught in public.

sides.snippet: To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
sides.verseText: He answered them, \"To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

sides.snippet: I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
sides.verseText: Jesus answered him, \"I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
